description: Every PandaDoc endpoint, plus an offline document pipeline no other PandaDoc tool has — stalled deals, aging, recipient engagement, and open quote value from a local store.

novel_features.name: Document pipeline funnel
novel_features.description: See your whole document funnel at a glance — how many are in draft, sent, viewed, completed, or declined.

novel_features.name: Stalled documents
novel_features.description: Find documents that were sent but never completed within N days — the deals quietly dying.

novel_features.name: Status aging report
novel_features.description: Show how long each document has sat in its current status, bucketed by age.

novel_features.name: Recipient engagement
novel_features.description: Rank recipients by how often they open and sign vs. let documents sit unread.

novel_features.name: Template velocity
novel_features.description: Per-template document counts and completion rates — which templates actually close.

novel_features.name: Open quote value
novel_features.description: Sum the quote/pricing totals across all open (non-completed) documents — your in-flight dollar value.

novel_features.name: Since-window changes
novel_features.description: Show what changed in the last N hours — new documents and status transitions.

novel_features.name: Webhook coverage audit
novel_features.description: Compare your active webhook subscriptions against the full event catalog to find gaps.

novel_features.name: Cold-client report
novel_features.description: Rank clients by how long since they last signed anything — spot the accounts going quiet.

novel_features.name: Pipeline value forecast
novel_features.description: Bucket open quote dollars into healthy, aging, and stalled tiers by deal age.

novel_features.name: Follow-up queue
novel_features.description: A ranked nudge worklist: stalled documents joined to recipient emails and days-since-sent, ready for outreach.

novel_features.name: Reminder gaps
novel_features.description: Find sent-but-incomplete documents that have no active auto-reminder set — queries the live API per document (needs PANDADOC_API_KEY).
